novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new measurement framing: “direct edges will survive representational conditioning on mediators while indirect edges will vanish,” coupled to the hypothesis that this structure governs in-silico perturbation propagation. Searches for “single-cell foundation model conditional independence d-separation,” “scGPT direct indirect gene regulation mediation,” and “causal structure neural gene representations” identify the closest work as Systematic Evaluation of Single-Cell Foundation Model Interpretability Reveals Attention Captures Co-Expression Rather Than Unique Regulatory Signal (2026), while Causal Dropout Model (ICLR 2024) and Model-X knockoffs work apply conditional-independence tests to expression-based GRN inference rather than to pretrained scFM internals. Moving from marginal scFM edge benchmarks to d-separation tests in representation space is therefore a substantive multi-step operationalization, but it remains a natural extension combining standard conditional-independence methodology with an established mechanistic-interpretability question rather than introducing a new causal principle or general-purpose paradigm.
